title: Image Tokenizers Should Be Trained Between Images
title_zh: 图像分词器应在图像之间进行训练

paragraphs.en: 图像分词器应在图像之间进行训练，以提升生成图像的质量。 Latent diffusion models generate images as codes of an image tokenizer, whose decoder turns them into the pixel image. Recent tokenizers improve how well these codes reconstruct an image and how easily a generator learns them. Yet a generator does not reproduce the codes of training images, and when a generated code lands outside what the decoder expects, the decoded image contains imperfections. Current methods make the decoder more robust to generated codes by adding noise during training. However, generated codes lie between the training codes and resemble their mixture more than one of them plus noise. To improve generated images, decoders should therefore be trained on codes in the space between training samples. We propose InterpTok, which fine-tunes MAETok to decode mixtures of image codes into natural images. Since no target image exists between two training samples, a discriminator judges whether each decoded mixture looks as natural as its two sources. A mixing ratio loss requires the decoded mixture to keep the mixing ratio of the two codes. Together, they prevent collapse to a trivial solution and yield a sharp and natural composition of both images. InterpTok keeps MAETok's reconstruction quality and improves interpolation quality more than threefold, the best of all tokenizers in a recent benchmark. Beyond interpolation, InterpTok improves the generation FID of a matched diffusion transformer from 11.61 to 8.48 without guidance, and even reaches 8.11 at an eighth of the sampling steps, where the generator on MAETok's codes worsens. The generator trained on our tokenizer also reaches the final result of the one trained on MAETok at half the training steps. Our findings show that the space between image codes can and should be explicitly supervised rather than ignored.
paragraphs.zh: 图像分词器应在图像之间进行训练，以提升生成图像的质量。潜在扩散模型将图像作为图像分词器的编码来生成，其解码器则将这些编码转换为像素图像。 近期的分词器改进了这些编码对图像的重建效果，并提升了生成器学习这些编码的便捷性。 然而，生成器无法复现训练图像的编码；当生成的编码超出解码器的预期范围时，解码后的图像会出现瑕疵。 当前方法通过在训练过程中添加噪声，使解码器对生成的编码更具鲁棒性。 不过，生成的编码位于训练编码之间，与其混合体更为相似，而非与其中一个编码加上噪声后的结果相似。 因此，为了提升生成图像的质量，解码器应在训练样本之间的编码空间上进行训练。 我们提出了 InterpTok，它通过微调 MAETok 来将图像编码的混合体解码为自然图像。 由于两个训练样本之间不存在目标图像，判别器会判断每个解码后的混合体是否与其两个来源一样自然。 混合比例损失要求解码后的混合体保持两个编码的混合比例。 这些方法共同防止了模型坍缩到平凡解，并生成了由两幅图像构成的清晰自然的组合。 InterpTok 保留了 MAETok 的重建质量，并将插值质量提升了三倍多，在最近一次基准测试中成为所有分词器中的最佳选择。 除了插值之外，InterpTok 在没有引导的情况下，将匹配扩散变换器的生成 FID 从 11.61 提升至 8.48；甚至在采样步数仅为八分之一时，FID 仍能达到 8.11，而使用 MAETok 编码的生成器此时表现则会变差。 在训练步数减半的情况下，基于我们分词器训练的生成器仍能达到基于 MAETok 训练的生成器的最终结果。 我们的研究结果表明，图像编码之间的空间应当被明确监督，而非被忽视。
